title: Chevron Signs 20-Year Power Deal With Microsoft for Massive Texas AI Hub
title_zh: 雪佛龙与微软签署为期 20 年的大型德克萨斯人工智能中心电力协议
summary: Chevron and Microsoft partner on a multi-gigawatt natural gas-powered data center project in West Texas.
summary_zh: 雪佛龙和微软在德克萨斯州西部合作开发了一个多吉瓦天然气供电的数据中心项目。

title: Qualcomm Nears Deal for AI Chip Startup Modular
title_zh: 高通接近与 AI 芯片初创公司 Modular 达成交易
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Qualcomm Inc. is in advanced talks to acquire Modular Inc.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——高通公司正在就收购 Modular 公司进行深入谈判。

title: United Microelectronics (UMC) Hits All-Time High on New Deal Buzz
title_zh: 联华电子 (UMC) 在新政热潮中创下历史新高
summary: United Microelectronics Corp. (NYSE:UMC) is one of the 10 Stocks Paying Off Big Time. United Microelectronics saw its share prices jump to a new all-time high, as investors loaded portfolios following reports that it is collaborating with Intel Corp.
summary_zh: 联华电子 (NYSE:UMC) 是 10 只回报丰厚的股票之一。联华电子的股价跃升至历史新高，因为有报道称联华电子正在与英特尔公司合作，投资者纷纷买入投资组合。

summary: (Bloomberg) -- Shares of stock-photo company Getty Images Holdings Inc.

title: Intel’s Surge on an Apple Chip Deal Means Investors Are Betting on Its Foundry, Says Bernstein’s Stacy Rasgon
title_zh: 伯恩斯坦的史黛西·拉斯冈 (Stacy Rasgon) 表示，英特尔对苹果芯片交易的激增意味着投资者正在押注于其代工厂
summary: Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) ripped higher last week after former President Donald Trump posted on Truth Social that Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had agreed to design and manufacture chips with Intel inside the United States. Intel closed up 10.64% at $133.99, with INTC stock now above $140.
